Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to edit virtual invites in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users may be unable to edit virtual invites in Microsoft Teams. 

More info: When attempting to edit virtual event invites, the page may not load.

Current status: We're reviewing impacted request IDs from the Microsoft Teams service where edit operations are failing to identify and isolate the source of impact. We're analyzing service telemetry and diagnostic data to determine whether a service-side issue is contributing to these failures.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact users attempting to edit virtual invites in Microsoft Teams. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.
